context_for_next_testing_agent: This was a pure confidence-check pass per the agent_to_agent_context_note — no new bugs were hunted beyond the explicit scope. One process note for future testing agents on this app: a brand-new/guest browser automation context on web will land on /language first, then be redirected by the root ConsentGuard to /consent BEFORE reaching /login (ConsentGuard's segment-exclusion list does not include 'login', so guests always complete consent first) — this is expected app behavior, not a bug, but it means a single browser_automation script call must chain language->consent->login->any target page sequentially (separate tool calls do not share localStorage/AsyncStorage state in this environment, so login must be redone per call that needs it). OSM geo autocomplete, /me nested-button fix, /women-shield and /emergency non-tappable SOS, /rights heading, Trusted Circle, Nearest Help, and the core API contracts) are CONFIRMED WORKING in this round.
